items.text: Northwind Outfitters Q3 board meeting minutes are now available to shareholders in the investor portal. Contact investorrelations@northwindoutfitters.com for access requests.

Voluntary Recall Notice: TrailPeak 2-Burner Camping Stoves (Model TP-2200)

Larkspur Gear is voluntarily recalling approximately 14,800 TrailPeak 2-Burner Camping Stoves sold between March 2024 and January 2025. In rare cases the fuel regulator can develop a hairline crack, which may allow gas to escape near the burner assembly. We have received nine reports of minor flare-ups; no injuries have been reported.

If you own a TP-2200, stop using it and check the serial number stamped on the underside of the stove base. Affected serial ranges begin with TP22-A through TP22-F. Do not return the stove to the store. Instead, visit larkspurgear.com/recalls/tp2200 and submit your serial number and shipping address to receive a free replacement regulator kit, typically shipped within 5-7 business days.

Customers with questions can reach our product safety team at safety@larkspurgear.com or 1-800-555-0147, Monday to Friday, 8am-6pm Central. Our support chatbot on the recalls page can also walk you through the serial number check if you're unsure where to look.

In this week's episode of The Margin Call, hosts Priya Deshmukh and Owen Hartley unpack Northwind Outfitters' surprise Q3 board meeting, where the company announced it would spin off its wholesale division. They also dig into the TrailPeak stove recall and what it signals about Larkspur Gear's supplier vetting. The episode runs 42 minutes and is available on all major podcast platforms; a full transcript is posted at themargincall.fm/episodes/118.

We post every voluntary and mandated recall here within 24 hours of an announcement. Each notice includes the affected model and serial ranges, a description of the hazard, and instructions for obtaining a repair kit, replacement, or refund.

Larkspur Gear works with independent testing labs to review field reports as they come in. When a pattern emerges, we notify the relevant regulator and publish a notice even if the risk appears low. Our quality team reviews every report submitted through the contact form, and the web support bot can help you locate your order number if you no longer have the packing slip.

If you believe you own an affected product and cannot find its notice, email recalls@larkspurgear.com with a photo of the item and its label.
Shareholders may request a copy of the Q3 board meeting minutes by writing to investorrelations@northwindoutfitters.com.
Episode 118 of The Margin Call is now streaming, covering the Northwind Outfitters spinoff and the TrailPeak recall.

Our customer-support chatbot is available 24/7 on the homepage and can answer questions about order status, returns, and recall notices. It cannot process refunds or change shipping addresses, so please contact a human agent at support@larkspurgear.com for those requests. Average human response time is currently under four hours.

From the Board: A Note on the Q3 Meeting

At our Q3 board meeting on October 22, the board approved a plan to separate the wholesale division into an independent company, subject to final regulatory review. The transaction is expected to close in the second half of next year. A summary of the resolution and the meeting minutes will be filed with the relevant authorities and posted to the investor portal.

Directors also reviewed the company's safety reporting process following the TrailPeak recall. The board asked management to commission an outside audit of supplier testing procedures and to report findings at the next meeting.

We know announcements like these raise questions for employees, retail partners, and shareholders alike. A town hall is scheduled for November 5, and questions can be submitted in advance to communications@northwindoutfitters.com. Our investor FAQ page includes a short automated assistant that can point you to the relevant filing if you're looking for a specific document.

Thanks for listening to The Margin Call. If you enjoyed this episode, please rate us on your podcast app and share it with a colleague. Show notes, including links to the Northwind Outfitters investor portal and the Larkspur Gear recall page, are available at themargincall.fm/episodes/118. Our producer uses an automated transcription tool, so minor errors in the transcript are possible.

Recall FAQ: TrailPeak TP-2200

Q: Do I need to send the whole stove back?
A: No. We only need your serial number and address so we can ship the replacement regulator kit.

Q: How long will the kit take to arrive?
A: Most kits ship within 5-7 business days. You'll get a tracking email once it's on its way.

Q: What if I bought the stove secondhand?
A: You're still eligible. Just provide the serial number if it's visible.

Q: Can the chatbot on this page check my serial number?
A: Yes, it can look up the affected ranges, but it can't issue refunds or change addresses. For anything beyond that, email safety@larkspurgear.com.
